diameterInterpretation: Convex light-curve reconstruction, 43 ± 4 km volume-equivalent diameter. This pole gives the preferred occultation fit; the rival pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Source-reported size uncertainty, not a local surface accuracy or an assumed Gaussian confidence interval.
calibration.diameterSemantics: Volume-equivalent diameter of selected archived shape; explicit published scale transfer where documented.
calibration.limitations: Ďurech 2011 describes this as a very elongated convex model. Both poles fit the 2004 occultation; selected pole(28,−72) fits particularly well and is preferred in DAMIT, but its rival is not rejected. Three video chords have reported timing errors of tenths of a second. Table 3 gives volume-equivalent 43±4 km for this pole; local surface relief is unresolved.
